### Jesus Goes Public
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-january-3-2025.html
Passage: John 2:5
Points:
- Running out of wine during a wedding feast threatened the host family with public humiliation.
- Even though Jesus had not yet performed any public miracles, Mary turned to Him in confidence.
- Jesus initially showed caution because public miracles would attract crowds seeking spectacle over truth.
- Mary instructed the servants to follow Jesus' instructions without hesitation.
- Jesus honored her faith by turning ordinary water into an abundance of high-quality wine.

### What Ever He Says, Do It
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-june-15-2010-11633225.html
Passage: John 2:5
Points:
- Mary observed the wedding wine running low and brought the urgent need directly to Jesus.
- She instructed the servants to obey whatever instructions Jesus gave them.
- The attendants demonstrated faith through immediate obedience, hauling water jars and serving the cup.
- Mary's direction to do whatever He says models total surrender to God's direction.
- Prompt obedience to God transforms an ordinary life into one with extraordinary spiritual purpose.
